publicReleaseNotes: First public release of Oncall: local rotas, overrides, now/next, a private ICS feed, recorded alert intake and incident coordination beside an existing pager, with a move-in kit for Opsgenie and PagerDuty exports. Paging is off and the existing pager stays authoritative. Run it on your own computer with `rer install`, `setup` and `dev`; see README.md and docs/install.md.

agentUpdateInstructions: This is the first public release; there is no earlier public version to update from. An installation held from before it upgrades in place through the unchanged migrations and the additive ones in filename order: back up first, preserve authored data, owner and account identities and every applied migration byte, and do not reset to upgrade. For a portable backup stop dev or preview and run rer export --output exports/NAME.rer; restore only into an empty destination with rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes after restoring the original private settings. rer deploy --dry-run validates locally and makes no provider requests; actual deployment refuses until a hosted release with an independent standby is approved. Paging stays off. No live provider, deployment or paging acceptance is claimed.
